reason: Premier Energies Limited has commissioned India's largest solar cell facility, increasing its manufacturing capacity to 10.6 GW and becoming the largest cell manufacturer in the country.
why_now: The company announced this significant capacity expansion and market leadership on September 21, 2026.
source_headlines: Premier Energies Limited: Premier Energies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 21, 2026, titled "Premier Energies Commissions India s Largest Solar Cell Facility, becomes largest Cell manufacturer with 10.6 GW capacity".
